title: TAP boot record
description: One manage.py boot run's durable, machine-legible outcome record (req-boot-obs-record, specs/spec-tap-boot-observability.md). Written incrementally under logs/boot/ — a per-run file plus a stable latest.boot-record.json pointer — so an aborted or killed boot still leaves the record through its last completed boundary. Named consumers: the /diagnose-failed-session-spawn skill, the spawn presenter, and integrated AI assistants (spec-ai-integration). The record carries no secret values (req-boot-obs-record-5).

record_version.description: Schema version of this record document; bumped on breaking shape changes.

run_id.description: UUIDv7 minted for this boot run; also the per-run filename stem (<run_id>.boot-record.json).

grid_id.description: The instance's TAP_GRID_ID (empty string when unset), tying the record to the grid it stood up.

profile.description: Boot profile id applied by this run (boot/<id>.boot.json), or null for an intentional auth-only --allow-empty standup.

started_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the run started.

finished_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the run reached a terminal outcome; null while running (or if the process was killed before finalizing).

outcome.description: Terminal outcome of the run. 'running' persists only when the process died before finalizing — treat a stale 'running' as a crash.

abort.description: Present only when outcome is 'aborted': the ABORT signal's domain + reason (req-boot-abort-signal) plus optional structured detail — failed_step (the population step label) and failing_checks (the failing collector self-test checks, req-boot-obs-abort-detail).

domain.description: Failing subsystem/stage, matching the ABORT signal's domain (e.g. 'boot').

reason.description: Short, secret-free cause line, matching the rendered TAP-ABORT reason.

failed_step.description: Label of the population step that failed (e.g. 'fire-collector:github_core:github_core', or 'preflight').

failing_checks.description: Failing collector self-test checks (CollectorSelfTestCheck.to_dict() payloads, redaction-safe per req-tap-cares-collector-self-test-13), each tagged with the collector key it came from.

variables.description: Resolved boot variables with provenance — the report surface req-boot-variable-resolution-3 promised. One entry per resolve, in resolution order.

section.description: Profile section the variable belongs to (e.g. 'population').

value.description: The effective value that won the precedence ladder.

source.description: Where the winning value came from: flag (reserved) / env / profile / default.

phases.description: Boot phases in execution order (auth, grid_infra, population, web), each bracketed with start/finish and outcome.

status.description: 'running' until the phase closes; then 'ok' or 'failed'.

finished_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 phase end; null while running.

steps.description: Population work in execution order: collector readiness preflights (type 'preflight', req-boot-obs-preflight) then the profile's seed-plugin / fire-collector steps. Each entry carries its outcome, duration, and — for collector entries — the CollectionJob id, summary, and (on failure) failing self-test checks.

status.description: Outcome: ok / failed / skipped (skipped = preflight disabled, or a fire step whose preflight failed under non-abort semantics, req-boot-obs-preflight-5).

plugin.description: seed-plugin entries: the plugin slug seeded.

key.description: preflight / fire-collector entries: the collector registry key — or, for the offline required-secret checks (req-boot-required-secrets-5), the bare 'scope:key' secret reference being verified.

job_id.description: Collector entries: the CollectionJob entity id this entry created (its self_test field holds the full readiness payload).

summary.description: Collector entries: the job's at-a-glance summary line.

bundles_seeded.description: seed-plugin entries: how many GRIFT bundles imported.

failed_bundles.description: seed-plugin entries: how many GRIFT bundles failed to import.

failing_checks.description: Failed collector entries: the failing self-test checks (redaction-safe payloads).

note.description: Free-text context (e.g. why an entry was skipped).
